source.provenance_note: LKM family IDs document workflow discovery and are not scientific citations. DOI entries identify representative scientific or method sources returned by LKM or already used by this repository.

coverage_definitions.direct: The current QMBED stack can express the model, solver path, and main observable; benchmark orchestration may still be external.
coverage_definitions.partial: Core ED kernels exist, but a first-class workflow still needs domain-specific basis construction, sweeps, post-processing, or solver orchestration.
coverage_definitions.beyond: At least one load-bearing scientific or differentiation capability is absent from the current QMBED stack.

applications.title: Symmetry-resolved Heisenberg and XXZ spectra
applications.benchmark_shape: Periodic L=20 spin-1/2 chain, Nup=10, momentum k=0, lowest four eigenpairs.
applications.primary_observable: Sector energies, total-spin or momentum labels, and symmetry reconstruction.
applications.validation: Residual below 1e-10; sector eigenvalues embed in the full spectrum; degeneracies match symmetry.

applications.title: Frustrated J1-J2 spin-gap and phase-boundary scan
applications.gradient_target: Ground-state energy and spin gap with respect to J2/J1.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=18, Sz=0 and Sz=1 sectors, nine J2/J1 points around the dimerization regime.
applications.primary_observable: Singlet-triplet gap and finite-size phase indicator.
applications.validation: Cross-sector residuals, smooth energy branches, and convergence under tighter eigensolver tolerance.
capability_gaps: Reusable parameter-sweep and finite-size-scaling orchestration.

applications.title: Transverse-field Ising criticality from gap and fidelity
applications.gradient_target: Ground-state projector and second derivative of energy with respect to field.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=18 TFIM, seven fields straddling g=1, two-state tracked ground subspace.
applications.primary_observable: Finite-size gap, subspace fidelity, and fidelity susceptibility.
applications.validation: Gauge invariance under rotations inside the tracked subspace and finite-difference agreement away from degeneracy.
capability_gaps: Native higher-order eigensolver derivatives for the AD variant.

applications.title: Magnetization plateaus in frustrated spin models
applications.gradient_target: Sector ground energies with respect to field and exchange couplings.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=16 frustrated chain, all Sz sectors, 21 magnetic-field values.
applications.primary_observable: Ground-state magnetization staircase and plateau widths.
applications.validation: Plateau endpoints agree with cross-sector level crossings and magnetization remains quantized.
capability_gaps: First-class cross-sector envelope construction and plateau detection.

applications.title: Multi-orbital Hubbard magnetic and orbital phase diagram
applications.gradient_target: Order parameters and gaps with respect to U, Hund coupling, and crystal fields.
applications.benchmark_shape: Four-site, two-orbital cluster at fixed filling over a 5x5 interaction grid.
applications.primary_observable: Spin, orbital occupations, charge gap, and phase labels.
applications.validation: Particle-number and spin-sector consistency; phase labels stable under solver tolerance tightening.
capability_gaps: Ergonomic multi-orbital local spaces and reusable multi-parameter phase-map execution.

applications.title: Bias-release transport in an interacting Hubbard chain
applications.gradient_target: Current trace with respect to hopping, interaction, and initial bias.
applications.benchmark_shape: Half-filled spinful Hubbard L=10, dimension 63504, 101 Krylov time points.
applications.primary_observable: Center-bond current and density-imbalance relaxation.
applications.validation: Norm and particle-number conservation; continuity-equation residual; time-step convergence.
capability_gaps: Adjoint time evolution for gradient-based fitting.

applications.title: Floquet heating, quasienergies, and effective Hamiltonians
applications.gradient_target: Quasienergy projectors and heating observables with respect to drive parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=10 driven Ising chain, two-step period, full Floquet unitary and stroboscopic evolution.
applications.primary_observable: Quasienergy phases, unitarity, energy absorption, and high-frequency effective Hamiltonian.
applications.validation: Unitary defect below 1e-10; eigenvalues lie on the unit circle; high-frequency limit matches the average Hamiltonian.
capability_gaps: Branch-consistent quasienergy tracking and matrix-free Floquet eigensolvers at larger size.

applications.title: Strong-coupling doublon formation and decay
applications.gradient_target: Doublon lifetime and dispersion with respect to U/t.
applications.benchmark_shape: Two particles on L=14, six U/t values, real-time propagation to t=20/t.
applications.primary_observable: Double-occupancy survival, bound-state dispersion, and conversion probability.
applications.validation: Norm conservation; large-U effective hopping scales as t^2/U; spectral and time-domain estimates agree.

applications.title: Many-body scar eigenstates and revival dynamics
applications.gradient_target: Revival fidelity with respect to constrained-model couplings.
applications.benchmark_shape: Periodic PXP L=24, constrained dimension 103682, targeted eigenpairs and two revival periods.
applications.primary_observable: Special-state overlaps, level spacing, return probability, and revival period.
applications.validation: Constrained-basis dimension, norm conservation, and reproducible revival peak above a fixed threshold.
capability_gaps: Targeted interior eigensolver orchestration for scar-state extraction.

applications.title: Perfect quantum state transfer in engineered spin chains
applications.gradient_target: Transfer fidelity with respect to bond couplings and timing.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=20 one-excitation sector with analytic square-root couplings and weak disorder.
applications.primary_observable: End-to-end transfer fidelity, arrival time, and robustness curve.
applications.validation: Clean-chain fidelity approaches one; probability is conserved; disorder trend is monotone in ensemble median.
capability_gaps: Batched disorder and gradient-aware coupling optimization.

applications.title: Single-particle addition and removal spectra of correlated electrons
applications.gradient_target: Spectral weights and peak locations with respect to Hamiltonian parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: Eight-site spinful Hubbard cluster, N to N+1 and N-1 sectors, 150-step Lanczos continued fraction.
applications.primary_observable: Momentum-resolved spectral function, quasiparticle weight, and gap.
applications.validation: Particle-addition/removal sum rules, nonnegative weight, and agreement with a dense Lehmann oracle at reduced size.
capability_gaps: Reusable momentum-resolved cross-sector operator construction.

applications.title: Dynamical spin structure factor
applications.gradient_target: Peak positions and integrated weight with respect to exchanges and fields.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=18 symmetry-reduced spin chain, momentum source operator, 150-step Lanczos spectrum.
applications.primary_observable: S(q,omega), dispersion, linewidth proxy, and spectral moments.
applications.validation: Positivity, zeroth-moment sum rule, and dense Lehmann agreement at L=10.

applications.title: Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering on Hubbard clusters
applications.gradient_target: RIXS intensity with respect to crystal fields, spin-orbit coupling, and core-hole potential.
applications.benchmark_shape: Cu-O cluster with ground, core-excited, and final sectors; 101 incident and loss energies.
applications.primary_observable: Kramers-Heisenberg intensity map and polarization dependence.
applications.validation: Nonnegative intensity, polarization symmetry, spectral-weight convergence, and reduced dense resolvent oracle.
capability_gaps: First-class Kramers-Heisenberg workflow, core-hole sectors, and polarization operators.

applications.title: Optical conductivity and Drude-weight diagnostics
applications.gradient_target: Conductivity spectrum and Drude weight with respect to hopping and interactions.
applications.benchmark_shape: Half-filled spinless fermion L=18, current operator, 150-step Lanczos response.
applications.primary_observable: Regular optical conductivity, integrated f-sum, and flux curvature.
applications.validation: f-sum rule, positivity for positive frequency, and finite-difference flux-curvature agreement.
capability_gaps: Reusable current operators, diamagnetic term, and Kubo post-processing.

applications.title: Anderson-impurity Green functions and Kondo crossover
applications.gradient_target: Impurity spectrum and occupancy with respect to bath energies and hybridizations.
applications.benchmark_shape: One interacting impurity plus six spinful bath orbitals, particle-hole symmetric and asymmetric cases.
applications.primary_observable: Impurity spectral function, occupancy, double occupancy, and low-energy scale proxy.
applications.validation: Spectral sum rule, particle-hole symmetry, Lehmann/resolvent agreement, and bath-discretization convergence.
capability_gaps: Impurity-model builder, bath discretization, and finite-temperature Lanczos orchestration.

applications.title: Interacting SSH topological transition
applications.gradient_target: Gap and polarization proxy with respect to dimerization and interaction.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=18 half-filled spinless SSH chain over seven dimerization values and three interactions.
applications.primary_observable: Many-body gap, edge charge, entanglement entropy, and flux response.
applications.validation: Chiral-limit spectral pairing, particle-number conservation, and 2pi flux periodicity.
capability_gaps: First-class many-body polarization or Berry-phase observable.

applications.title: Fractional quantum Hall spectra and trial-state overlaps
applications.gradient_target: Gap and overlap with respect to pseudopotentials and geometry.
applications.benchmark_shape: Eight electrons on the sphere with flux chosen for a target filling and angular-momentum sectors.
applications.primary_observable: Low-energy multiplets, neutral gap, trial-state overlap, and flux evolution.
applications.validation: Angular-momentum degeneracies, overlap normalization, and particle-hole or model-limit checks.
capability_gaps: Landau-level orbitals, magnetic translations or spherical angular momentum, and pseudopotential builders.

applications.title: Moiré fractional Chern insulator identification
applications.gradient_target: Many-body gap, Chern projector, and entanglement spectrum with respect to continuum-model parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: Projected 6x4 Chern band at fractional filling with 2D momentum sectors and twisted boundaries.
applications.primary_observable: Ground-state manifold, spectral flow, many-body Chern number, and particle entanglement spectrum.
applications.validation: Topological degeneracy, 2pi flux return, integer manifold Chern number, and entanglement counting.
capability_gaps: Projected-band matrix elements, 2D translation sectors, twisted-boundary Berry curvature, and particle entanglement spectrum.

applications.title: Majorana parity splitting and effective Hamiltonians
applications.gradient_target: Parity splitting and zero-mode localization with respect to chemical potential and field.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=16 interacting or quadratic Kitaev-type chain in even and odd parity sectors.
applications.primary_observable: Parity gap, zero-mode profile, and topological phase boundary.
applications.validation: Exponential finite-size splitting in the topological regime and bulk gap-closing condition.
capability_gaps: Reusable fermion-parity sectors for general bases and topological projector diagnostics.

applications.title: Adiabatic braiding and non-Abelian Berry matrices
applications.gradient_target: Braiding fidelity and leakage with respect to path and timing.
applications.benchmark_shape: Six to eight Majorana modes, 100-point closed control path, tracked low-energy manifold.
applications.primary_observable: Non-Abelian Berry matrix, geometric phase, leakage, and gate fidelity.
applications.validation: Gauge-covariant Wilson loop, path closure, unitarity inside the manifold, and time-step convergence.
capability_gaps: Degenerate-manifold parallel transport, Wilson loops, and adiabatic leakage analysis.

applications.title: Collective emission, bright states, and subradiance
applications.gradient_target: Decay modes and emission intensity with respect to geometry and collective rates.
applications.benchmark_shape: Eight emitters with collective decay, matrix-free Liouvillian density-matrix evolution.
applications.primary_observable: Bright/dark decay rates, intensity pulse, and subradiant population.
applications.validation: Trace and Hermiticity preservation, positivity tolerance, and analytic Dicke-limit decay.
capability_gaps: Geometry-to-collective-rate builders.

applications.title: Lindblad steady states and Liouvillian gaps
applications.gradient_target: Steady state and Liouvillian gap with respect to Hamiltonian and jump rates.
applications.benchmark_shape: Driven dissipative L=8 spin chain, matrix-free Liouvillian dimension 65536.
applications.primary_observable: Steady-state density matrix, relaxation gap, purity, and local observables.
applications.validation: L(rho)=0 residual, unit trace, Hermiticity, positivity tolerance, and agreement with time evolution.
capability_gaps: Dedicated trace-constrained steady-state eigensolver.

applications.title: Quantum-trajectory unraveling of open dynamics
applications.gradient_target: Trajectory-averaged observables with respect to jump rates and controls.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=10 spin chain, 1000 reproducibly seeded jump trajectories and matched master equation at L=6.
applications.primary_observable: Jump-count statistics, survival probability, and trajectory-averaged density observables.
applications.validation: Ensemble convergence to the Lindblad solution, probability normalization, and seed reproducibility.
capability_gaps: Quantum-jump and diffusive trajectory engines, batched random streams, and ensemble reduction.

applications.title: Photon blockade and g2 correlations in cavity QED
applications.gradient_target: g2(0) and transmission with respect to drive, detuning, and loss.
applications.benchmark_shape: Two emitters plus photon cutoff 16, driven Lindblad steady state over 21 detunings.
applications.primary_observable: Photon number, g2(0), transmission, and blockade minimum.
applications.validation: Cutoff convergence, positivity, trace one, and weak-drive analytic limit.
capability_gaps: Steady-state correlation helpers and reusable cavity-drive/jump construction.

applications.title: Dicke superradiant transition with photon-cutoff control
applications.gradient_target: Ground-state energy and photon occupation with respect to coupling.
applications.benchmark_shape: Four spins with photon cutoffs 16, 24, and 32 over nine couplings around criticality.
applications.primary_observable: Gap, photon occupation, spin polarization, and cutoff error.
applications.validation: Monotone cutoff convergence, parity symmetry, and approach to the analytic critical coupling.
capability_gaps: Automated local-cutoff convergence and collective-spin sector support.

applications.title: Few-electron quantum-dot configuration interaction
applications.gradient_target: Addition energies and densities with respect to confinement and magnetic field.
applications.benchmark_shape: Twelve Fock-Darwin orbitals with four electrons, fixed angular momentum and spin sectors.
applications.primary_observable: Low-energy spectrum, shell filling, density, total angular momentum, and addition energy.
applications.validation: Noninteracting shell limit, center-of-mass checks, sector quantum numbers, and basis-cutoff convergence.
capability_gaps: Continuum-orbital integrals, angular-momentum sectors, and configuration-interaction import format.

applications.title: Nuclear shell-model spectroscopy
applications.gradient_target: Level energies and transition strengths with respect to effective interaction matrix elements.
applications.benchmark_shape: sd-shell valence problem with dimension about 1e5 and targeted J sectors.
applications.primary_observable: Excitation spectrum, spin-parity labels, and electromagnetic transition strengths.
applications.validation: Angular-momentum algebra, known benchmark levels, residuals, and sum rules.
capability_gaps: Angular-momentum-coupled bases, two-body matrix-element formats, and transition operators.

applications.title: Molecular full-CI ground and excited states
applications.gradient_target: Energies, oscillator strengths, and reduced density matrices with respect to one- and two-electron integrals.
applications.benchmark_shape: CAS(10e,10o), spin-resolved determinant basis, lowest six states.
applications.primary_observable: State energies, spin, one- and two-body reduced density matrices, and transition dipoles.
applications.validation: Hermiticity, trace and contraction identities of RDMs, spin labels, and comparison with an external FCI oracle.
capability_gaps: General quantum-chemistry integral ingestion, spin-adapted CI, RDMs, and transition properties.

applications.title: Hamiltonian truncation in quantum field theory
applications.gradient_target: Low-energy masses with respect to couplings and truncation counterterms.
applications.benchmark_shape: Truncated Fock basis up to dimension 1e5 at four energy cutoffs.
applications.primary_observable: Low-lying spectrum, mass gap, matrix elements, and cutoff extrapolation.
applications.validation: Residuals, symmetry sectors, monotone or fitted cutoff convergence, and solvable-limit comparison.
capability_gaps: Energy-truncated Fock bases, renormalization counterterms, and continuum-limit extrapolation.

applications.title: Self-consistent BdG vortices and inhomogeneous superconductivity
applications.gradient_target: Gap field and LDOS with respect to pairing interaction, disorder, and field.
applications.benchmark_shape: 24x24 lattice BdG matrix with vortex or impurity, up to 50 self-consistency iterations.
applications.primary_observable: Spatial gap, vortex bound states, Majorana weight, and LDOS.
applications.validation: Particle-hole spectral symmetry, self-consistency residual, lattice-size convergence, and LDOS sum rule.
capability_gaps: BdG/Nambu assembly, self-consistent nonlinear loop, 2D geometry, and local spectral maps.

applications.title: Finite-temperature magnetic susceptibility fitting
applications.gradient_target: Susceptibility with respect to exchange constants, g factor, and impurity fraction.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=16 full-spectrum or L=24 finite-temperature Lanczos over 50 temperatures.
applications.primary_observable: Susceptibility, heat capacity, fitted parameters, and uncertainty estimates.
applications.validation: High-temperature Curie limit, analytic dimer oracle, finite-difference gradient, and held-out temperature error.
capability_gaps: Finite-temperature Lanczos, differentiable thermal traces, and fit/uncertainty orchestration.

applications.title: Thermal states, typicality, and thermalization diagnostics
applications.gradient_target: Thermal observables with respect to temperature and Hamiltonian parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=18 spin chain with exact small-size Gibbs oracle and stochastic typicality at target size.
applications.primary_observable: Partition function ratios, energy, entropy, local observables, and post-quench thermalization error.
applications.validation: Trace and positivity, thermodynamic identities, seed convergence, and agreement with exact L=12 results.
capability_gaps: Typicality/FTLM primitives and reproducible stochastic trace estimation.

applications.title: Anderson localization and multifractal eigenstates
applications.gradient_target: IPR and multifractal exponents with respect to disorder.
applications.benchmark_shape: Three-dimensional Anderson lattice 20^3, 20 interior eigenpairs, five disorder strengths.
applications.primary_observable: IPR, participation entropy, level spacing, and finite-size multifractal exponents.
applications.validation: Residuals, orthogonality, known clean/disordered trends, and reproducible disorder seeds.
capability_gaps: Distributed sparse shift-invert for larger single-particle lattices.

applications.title: Many-body localization level statistics and eigenstate observables
applications.gradient_target: Disorder-averaged statistics with respect to disorder strength.
applications.benchmark_shape: Random-field Heisenberg L=18, Nup=9, 50 disorder samples, 20 mid-spectrum eigenpairs each.
applications.primary_observable: Adjacent-gap ratio, entanglement entropy, spin imbalance, and sample uncertainty.
applications.validation: Shift-invert residuals, deterministic seeds, confidence intervals, and known GOE-to-Poisson trend.
capability_gaps: Parallel disorder ensembles and robust interior-eigensolver resource control.

applications.title: ED certification of variational many-body ansatzes
applications.gradient_target: Variational loss and fidelity with respect to ansatz parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=20 spin model, batch of 100 normalized trial states or neural-network ansatz snapshots.
applications.primary_observable: Variational energy error, fidelity, variance, and gap-aware certificate.
applications.validation: Evar is above E0, variance is nonnegative, and independently normalized states reproduce direct expectation values.
capability_gaps: Batched state observables and a stable external-ansatz interchange format.

applications.title: Entanglement entropy and mixed-state negativity
applications.gradient_target: Entanglement measures with respect to Hamiltonian and state parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=18 pure-state bipartition plus L=8 mixed-state partial transpose.
applications.primary_observable: Von Neumann/Renyi entropy, entanglement spectrum, and logarithmic negativity.
applications.validation: Schmidt-spectrum normalization, product/Bell-state oracles, subsystem symmetry, and nonnegative negativity.
capability_gaps: Mixed-state partial transpose and entanglement negativity helpers.

applications.title: Quantum Fisher information near many-body transitions
applications.gradient_target: Ground-state projector or density matrix with respect to the encoded parameter.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=16 spin chain over seven control parameters with pure-state and thermal QFI.
applications.primary_observable: QFI, susceptibility, scaling exponent, and optimal generator.
applications.validation: Pure-state variance identity, finite-difference fidelity relation, positivity, and reduced-size spectral oracle.
capability_gaps: First-class pure/mixed-state QFI and symmetric-logarithmic-derivative solvers.

applications.title: Differentiable closed-system pulse optimization
applications.gradient_target: Gate or state fidelity with respect to 100-200 pulse amplitudes.
applications.benchmark_shape: Six truncated transmons or 16 sparse spins, piecewise-constant controls, forward/backward propagation.
applications.primary_observable: Final fidelity, leakage, pulse fluence, and exact discrete-time gradient.
applications.validation: Directional finite differences, value-plus-gradient cost ratio, norm/unitarity, and optimizer convergence.
capability_gaps: Reverse-mode propagation, control-parameter tapes, checkpointing, and optimizer-facing objective API.

applications.title: Differentiable dissipative state preparation
applications.gradient_target: Steady-state or terminal-state fidelity with respect to coherent controls and jump rates.
applications.benchmark_shape: Two qubits plus cavity cutoff 20, Lindblad dynamics, 100 control pixels.
applications.primary_observable: Target-state fidelity, purity, leakage, and control robustness.
applications.validation: Adjoint-vs-finite-difference gradients, trace preservation, positivity tolerance, and pulse refinement convergence.
capability_gaps: Adjoint sensitivities for matrix-free Lindblad evolution and implicit steady-state differentiation.

applications.title: Many-body sensing protocol optimization
applications.gradient_target: Sensing error or QFI with respect to controls, interactions, and readout time.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=16 interacting spin sensor with sparse Krylov propagation and 100 control variables.
applications.primary_observable: QFI, robust fidelity, noise sensitivity, and optimized pulse profile.
applications.validation: Gradient directional checks, monotone objective reduction, QFI bounds, and robustness under held-out perturbations.
capability_gaps: Differentiable sparse evolution, QFI objectives, and robust batched optimization.

applications.title: Automatic-differentiation fidelity susceptibility
applications.gradient_target: Second derivative of the ground-state energy and ground-state projector.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=20 TFIM, dominant sparse eigensolver only, fields around criticality.
applications.primary_observable: Fidelity susceptibility and second energy derivative without a full spectrum.
applications.validation: Agreement with dense/spectral-sum oracle at L=12, finite differences away from criticality, and no full-spectrum allocation.
capability_gaps: Custom reverse and higher-order rules for a dominant sparse eigensolver.

applications.title: Learning effective spin Hamiltonians from thermodynamics
applications.gradient_target: Thermal loss with respect to exchange, anisotropy, g factor, and nuisance parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=12 spin model, five unknown couplings, 50 temperatures, synthetic train/test split.
applications.primary_observable: Recovered Hamiltonian parameters and predicted susceptibility/correlation curves.
applications.validation: Gradient-vs-finite-difference check, parameter recovery tolerance, held-out error, and uncertainty calibration.
capability_gaps: Differentiable thermal traces, constrained parameter transforms, and batched inverse-problem objectives.

applications.title: Inverse design of highly entangled ground states
applications.gradient_target: Entanglement and spectral-gap loss with respect to local Hamiltonian couplings.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=16 spin chain, 20-40 couplings, dominant two-state eigensolve per optimizer step.
applications.primary_observable: Target entanglement, gap, locality penalty, and optimized Hamiltonian.
applications.validation: Directional gradients, projector-gauge invariance, independent re-diagonalization, and held-out perturbation robustness.
capability_gaps: Differentiable eigensolver, degeneracy regularization, and composable Hamiltonian-design objectives.

applications.title: Inverse spectral fitting of transmon-resonator Hamiltonians
applications.gradient_target: Transition frequencies with respect to Josephson, charging, coupling, and resonator parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: A 50-200 dimensional truncated circuit Hamiltonian, 20 observed lines, parity averaging.
applications.primary_observable: Fitted device parameters, transition spectrum, and residual covariance.
applications.validation: Synthetic parameter recovery, gradient directional checks, label/permutation robustness, and held-out line prediction.
capability_gaps: Circuit-QED local spaces, differentiable eigenvalue matching, and assignment-aware spectral loss.

applications.title: Hamiltonian reconstruction from time-dependent observables
applications.gradient_target: Time-series loss with respect to Hamiltonian matrix elements or operator coefficients.
applications.benchmark_shape: Eight-site interacting model, 20 unknown coefficients, 100 observation times and multiple initial states.
applications.primary_observable: Recovered couplings, predicted trajectories, and identifiability diagnostics.
applications.validation: Gradient check, synthetic recovery, train/held-out trajectory error, and symmetry-constrained identifiability.
capability_gaps: Differentiable time evolution, multi-trajectory batching, and parameterized operator dictionaries.

applications.title: Reverse-mode dominant sparse eigensolver
applications.gradient_target: Scalar losses depending on selected eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
applications.benchmark_shape: Hermitian sparse operator of dimension about 1e6, k=1-4 extremal eigenpairs, matrix-free action.
applications.primary_observable: Vector-Jacobian products, backward residual, memory, and value-plus-gradient runtime.
applications.validation: Low-rank adjoint linear-system residual, dense oracle at small size, directional derivatives, and no full eigendecomposition.
capability_gaps: Custom VJP/JVP using projected linear solves and matrix-free transpose/adjoint actions.

applications.title: Degenerate-subspace and spectral-projector differentiation
applications.gradient_target: Gauge-invariant losses of a near-degenerate eigen-subspace.
applications.benchmark_shape: Two- and fourfold manifolds with tunable splitting inside dimension 1e5 sparse models.
applications.primary_observable: Projector derivative, subspace fidelity, Berry connection, and condition diagnostics.
applications.validation: Invariance under arbitrary basis rotations, stable zero-splitting limit, directional derivatives, and gap-dependent error report.
capability_gaps: Clustered-eigenvalue projectors, gauge-covariant derivatives, and degeneracy-aware regularization.

applications.title: Differentiable sparse Krylov time evolution
applications.gradient_target: Terminal and path-dependent losses with respect to Hamiltonian and control parameters.
applications.benchmark_shape: L=18 sparse spin model, 200 time steps, 100-200 parameters, checkpointed forward/backward passes.
applications.primary_observable: State and observable gradients, peak memory, recomputation cost, and optimizer progress.
applications.validation: Directional finite differences, exact small dense exponential oracle, norm conservation, and tolerance refinement.
capability_gaps: Custom differentiation for expm-multiply/Krylov, checkpoint policy, and time-dependent parameter tapes.

applications.title: Differentiable impurity and NRG-style iterative diagonalization
applications.gradient_target: Impurity observables with respect to bath, interaction, and hybridization parameters across truncation steps.
applications.benchmark_shape: One impurity plus eight bath sites or a short NRG chain, repeated truncated eigensolves.
applications.primary_observable: Ground energy, occupancy, susceptibility, spectrum, and gradients through truncation.
applications.validation: Finite-difference gradients, truncation convergence, stability near level crossings, and forward-value agreement.
capability_gaps: Differentiable truncation/projector semantics, iterative eigensolver tapes, and bath-fitting objectives.

applications.title: Differentiable CI and variational few-body basis optimization
applications.gradient_target: Generalized eigenvalue and property loss with respect to basis exponents and one-/two-electron integrals.
applications.benchmark_shape: CAS(8e,8o) or correlated-Gaussian few-body basis with 50-100 trainable parameters.
applications.primary_observable: Ground/excited energies, basis condition number, RDM/property gradients, and optimization convergence.
applications.validation: Directional gradients, generalized-eigenproblem residual, degeneracy tests, and comparison with an independent integral/CI oracle.
capability_gaps: Differentiable generalized eigensolver, integral gradients, stable orthogonalization, and degeneracy-safe property derivatives.
